query: Classically, two stem cell self-renewal strategies have been proposed (Potten and Loeffler, 1990; Simons and Clevers, 2011a): following the Invariant Asymmetric division (IA) strategy, stem cells undertake only asymmetric divisions, whose outcome is one differentiating cell and one stem cell as daughter cells.
